about: A region is identified by its coordinates, structurally and in one order, so two folds of one region are one value
wherever they are computed; a change folds again only the regions that contain it, one per resolution.
Inside a region one step may be any step and a run of steps any run; a region ending in either is the region before it.

cases.name: a region's identity does not depend on order
a change touches the regions that contain it
any one step meets one step
any one step is not zero steps
any one step fixes the steps after it
a run of steps may be empty
a run of steps may be long
a trailing run is the region before it
a trailing step is the region before it

coverage.criterion: identity under reordering and under a different coordinate, the regions one change touches, and each wildcard: one step against one, zero and a wrong tail; a run empty, long, after a step, and trailing
coverage.why: hand-written over names; a wildcard pattern not listed here can still mismatch
